state:
Goal `core-request-1-2`: `Core\Request::body`, `bytes`, `bodyStream`, `clientIp`, `cookie` and `files`
have all their feature proofs. `bun nv proofs --verify --only` over those six says nothing owed.
A proof program answers a request through the `<name>.nvsr` beside it (`docs/examples/README.md` §
*A request for the program*, and `crates/nvs-test/src/request.rs`'s module doc for every section).
A multipart body is written under `--BODY_CRLF--`. A new bench is measured with `bun nv proofs
--record-perf --only <members>`. `bun nv verify` regenerates `docs/novis.md` from the rewritten
cards. Five members of `Core\Request (1/2)` still owe their proofs, in the order the check lists them.
